item.title: SEC proposes Regulation Crypto Assets, a new bespoke offering regime for crypto with $5M and $75M exemptions; 60-day comment period open.
Coldcard firmware flaw allows seed-phrase reconstruction remotely; attackers drain roughly $130M from 4,585 Bitcoin wallets since July 30.
Japan registers Nomura-backed Laser Digital as first new crypto entrant in four years after reclassifying crypto as financial instruments.
U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs draw $1.9B in weekly net inflows for the week ended August 21; spot Ethereum ETFs add $697M in the same period.
JPMorgan Q2 13F discloses $356M in BlackRock IBIT and quadrupled iShares ETH position; Morgan Stanley raises Fidelity FBTC by 38%.
EU Commission MiCA review consultation closes August 31, covering stablecoin caps, CASP licensing, and potential DeFi provisions.
U.S. Senate pushes CLARITY Act procedural vote to September 15 after Democratic objections over DeFi and ethics provisions.
EU Travel Rule now applies a zero-euro threshold to stablecoin transfers, requiring full sender and recipient data on all transactions.
X is exploring USDC stablecoin payouts for content creators as it sunsets its existing creator revenue-sharing program on September 7.
Wanchain's Cardano-BNB Chain bridge loses $13M in a hack, representing roughly 97% of the bridge's total reserves.
Coinsbuy centralized exchange loses $8M in a coordinated attack spanning Tron and Ethereum wallets on August 9.
Maya Protocol DeFi platform exploited via six chained logic bugs on August 18; $1.7M in direct losses, roughly $11M broader market impact.
SafePal discloses breach of 39,798 customer records including names and shipping addresses; private keys and funds were not exposed.
